services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Sheffield

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Full redecoration of living spaces, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality finishes, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your property's exterior. We tackle woodwork, render, brick, and masonry with weather-resistant paints built to last.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Expert wallpaper selection and installation. We handle tricky corners, pattern matching, and removal of old paper with minimal disruption.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Specialist finishing for doors, skirting boards, stairs, and built-in furniture. Sanding, priming, and perfect paint finishes every time.

services.title: Exterior Render & Cladding
services.desc: Renovation and repainting of rendered walls and cladding. We prepare surfaces thoroughly to ensure long-lasting colour and protection.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and industrial repainting. Scheduled outside business hours with minimal disruption and professional results.

about_pullquote: I only do work I'd be proud to show my own family.
about_para_1: Chris Peat has been painting and decorating across Sheffield for over 20 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local business known for meticulous preparation, quality finishes, and honest pricing. Every job—whether a small room freshen-up or a full property renovation—gets the same level of care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, doing the job right, and leaving your home spotless. We listen to what you want, give straight advice about what will work best, and stick to our quotes. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals—the best compliment we can ask for.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge and hallway done. Chris was punctual, tidy, and the finish is brilliant. He took care moving furniture and didn't leave any mess. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Excellent work on our exterior. We were worried about the woodwork after years of weather, but Chris sorted it completely. Great communication throughout, fair price, and the paint job is flawless.
reviews.author: Helen K.

reviews.text: Used Chris for wallpaper hanging in the bedroom and painting the kitchen. He's careful with detail, sorted the prep work properly, and finished on schedule. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: Paul T.
